chips.t: Girl: Hi, Charlie. Did you know the circus is in town?

Charlie: Yes, I did! I think the circus is the most exciting place in the world.

chips.t: Girl: Does he often play it?
Charlie: Yes, but when he listens to it, he goes to sleep!
chips.zh: 查理：是的，但是当他听的时候，他就睡着了！
